questions.note: The other two Civic recalls (23V858000, 26V332000) were received in 2023 and 2026.

questions.question: Which complaints about the 2019 Subaru Outback were filed in 2019?
questions.note: Complaint 11123359 about the same vehicle was filed on 08/29/2018.

questions.question: Which complaints about 2019 model-year vehicles report that the vehicle does not accelerate when the gas pedal is pressed?

chunks.quote: VEHICLE WILL NOT ACCELERATE WHEN PUSHING DOWN ON THE GAS PEDAL.

questions.note: The 2015 Ford Escape complaints 10689793 and 10692693 report hesitation on acceleration, but the vehicle is a 2015 model.

questions.question: Which recall campaigns affecting the 2019 Toyota RAV4 concern the fuel pump?
Which vehicles do owners report braking on its own or suddenly?

chunks.quote: THE VEHICLE MAY BRAKE SUDDENLY, RAPIDLY DECELERATE, AND QUICKLY DEPART THE HIGHWAY WHEN APPROACHING EXIT RAMPS.
THE CAR BRAKED ON ITS OWN.

questions.note: The Civic's "MAY BRAKE SUDDENLY" describes what the owner saw happen ("THE VEHICLE DID THIS TWICE"), so it counts.

questions.question: Which vehicle is affected by the most recall campaigns in the data?
questions.note: Escape 9 recalls, RAV4 7, Civic 5, Rogue 5, Outback 3.

questions.question: How many owner complaints in the data report a crash?
Which complaint component category appears in the most complaints?
questions.note: A complaint can list several categories: FUEL/PROPULSION SYSTEM is in 5 complaints, ENGINE and POWER TRAIN in 4 each.

questions.question: How many complaints report a dead battery?

chunks.quote: HAD A DEAD BATTERY ALREADY ON A 2019 VEHICLE.
DEAD BATTERY IF THE CARS SITS PARKED 2 DAYS.

Which engine recall campaign belongs to the vehicle whose owners report a piston ring recall?

chunks.quote: PISTON CLIP RING RECALL FROM HONDA
PISTON SNAP RING RECALL

questions.question: Which engine recall campaign affects the vehicle of complaint 10823637, whose own record carries a piston claim?

chunks.quote: PISTON CLIP RING RECALL FROM HONDA

questions.question: The owner in complaint 10692693 had parts replaced on the transmission. Which recall campaigns for that vehicle concern the transmission?

chunks.quote: VEHICLE WAS IN FORD REPAIR SHOP FOR 12 DAYS WITH 1200 WORTH OF PARTS REPLACED ON TRANSMISSION.

questions.question: Which recall campaigns concern the back-up camera of a vehicle whose owner complains that the back-up camera stopped working?

chunks.quote: THE SYSTEM FREEZES UP COMPLETELY CAUSING EVERYTHING NOT WORK RADIO BACK UP CAMERA ETC.

questions.note: Only the Outback owner complains about the back-up camera, and no Outback recall concerns a camera (structure, fuel pump twice). The camera recalls 19V576000 (RAV4) and 25V695000 (Escape) belong to vehicles whose owners do not mention a camera.

questions.question: Which fuel pump recall affects a vehicle whose owner complains about filling the fuel tank?

chunks.quote: WHEN FILLING MY TANK, AUTO-SHUTOFF HAPPENS WHEN THE TANK IS AT LEAST 2 GALLONS SHY OF BEING FULL.

questions.note: The Rogue owner of complaint 11032133 complains about the gas gauge, not filling, and the Rogue has no fuel pump recall.

questions.question: The owner in complaint 10825467 asks about the piston snap ring recall that has no fix yet. What will dealers do under that recall's remedy?

expected.text: Inspect and replace the piston assemblies and damaged engine components as necessary, free of charge.

chunks.quote: CONTACTED AMERICAN HONDA TODAY IN REGARDS TO PISTON SNAP RING RECALL.
dealers will inspect and replace the piston assemblies and damaged engine components, as necessary, free of charge.

questions.note: Two documents: the complaint names the recall only by its part; the recall text 16V074000 gives the remedy.

questions.question: The owner in complaint 10824361 was sold a 2016 Honda Civic the day after a recall and stop of sale. What defect does the engine recall for that vehicle describe?

expected.text: Piston assemblies that may have been made without a piston wrist pin circlip, or with the circlip installed incorrectly, in 2.0L engines.

chunks.quote: I WAS SOLD A BRAND NEW 2016 HONDA CIVIC THE DAY AFTER A RECALL AND STOP OF SALE WAS ISSUED.
The affected vehicles have engines with piston assemblies that may have been manufactured without a piston wrist pin circlip or with an incorrectly installed piston wrist pin circlip.

questions.question: Which vehicles do owners report with a cracked windshield?

chunks.quote: WINDSHIELD CRACK APPEARED OVERNIGHT ON THE 4TH DAY OF OWNERSHIP.
WINDSHIELD SPONTANEOUSLY CRACKED AT THE BASE OF THE WINDSHIELD

questions.note: Recall texts name other cracks (the engine block heater of 26V011000, the seat weight sensor of 26V332000, the suspension arms of 20V286000, the engine castings of 20V064000); none is a windshield or an owner's report.

questions.question: Which vehicles do owners report with a transmission that switched to reverse on its own?

chunks.quote: THE TRANSMISSION ERRONEOUSLY SWITCHED TO REVERSE AND THE VEHICLE MOVED BACKWARDS.

questions.note: The Escape had transmission parts replaced and the RAV4's gear shifter came out of the transmission box: other transmission problems.

questions.question: Which NHTSA recall campaign does Ford number 22S25?

chunks.quote: Ford's number for this recall is 22S25.

questions.note: 22V413000 has the same shifter bushing remedy but is Ford's 22S43.

questions.question: Which door latch recall re-inspects latches whose earlier repair may not have been completed properly?

chunks.quote: These vehicles were previously recalled and repaired under recalls 15V-246, 16V-643 or 17V-210, however the repair may not have been completed properly.

questions.note: 16V643000 is the original door latch recall.

questions.question: Which of the two Subaru fuel pump recalls also covers Toyota 86 vehicles?

chunks.quote: 2018-2019 BRZ, WRX, and Toyota 86 vehicles.

questions.note: 20V218000 covers 2019 Impreza, Outback, Legacy and Ascent vehicles only.

questions.question: Which of the two RAV4 load label recalls was issued by Gulf States Toyota?

chunks.quote: Gulf States Toyota (GST) is recalling certain 2019 C-HR

questions.note: 19V503000, also about a load capacity label, is Southeast Toyota Distributors'.

questions.question: Which vehicles do owners report with air bags that failed to deploy?

chunks.quote: THE VEHICLE CRASHED INTO A WALL AND THE AIR BAGS FAILED TO DEPLOY.

questions.note: Recall 16V244000 says the Rogue's passenger air bag "may be turned off and not deploy": a possibility stated by the maker, not an owner's report.

questions.question: How many complaints report that the vehicle actually stalled?

chunks.quote: LESS THAN A WEEK LATER VEHICLE STARTED STALLING AT TRAFFIC LIGHTS AND HESITATING UPON ACCELERATION.

questions.note: Complaint 10823637 names stalling only as a possible result of the recalled part ("THE RESULT OF THIS PART FAILURE IS ENGINE FAILURE, AND/OR STALLING"); complaint 11209676 says "THE ENGINE DOES NOT STOP RUNNING".

questions.question: Which complaints report that repair work was done on the vehicle?

chunks.quote: 3RD TIME, PADS CHANGED AND ROTORS MACHINED.
VEHICLE WAS IN FORD REPAIR SHOP FOR 12 DAYS WITH 1200 WORTH OF PARTS REPLACED ON TRANSMISSION.

questions.note: Negated repairs do not count: 10667633 and 10691672 ("THE VEHICLE WAS NOT REPAIRED"), 10957753 and 11205702 ("NOT DIAGNOSED OR REPAIRED"), 10689793 ("NO REPAIRS NEEDED OR MADE").

questions.question: Which vehicles did owners report being in a rear-end collision?

chunks.quote: A REAR END COLLISION WAS NARROWLY AVOIDED IN ONE CASE.

questions.note: The only rear-end collision in the data was avoided; the two crashes (Escape, Rogue) were into walls.

questions.question: Which vehicles' owners report that the vehicle crashed?

chunks.quote: THE VEHICLE CRASHED INTO A WALL
I PUMPED ON THE BRAKE PEDAL TWICE BEFORE HITTING THE CONCRETE WALL ON THE 6TH FLOOR OF THE STRUCTURE.

questions.note: The Civic's rear-end collision was "NARROWLY AVOIDED" and the RAV4's problem "COULD CAUSE AN ACCIDENT": neither is a crash.

chunks.quote: THE TRUNK AND GLOVE COMPARTMENT DO NOT LOCK

questions.note: Here the negation is the claim: a graph that drops it would store a trunk that locks.
